channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Defesa de Lulinha diz que 'direcionamento' de Mendonça deve gerar arquivamento
item.description: The defense of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva stated in a press release that the Federal Police intelligence report mentioning Mendonça's direction should lead to the case being archived, claiming there are no irregularities.

item.title: Defesa de Lulinha vê relatório da PF como argumento para arquivar investigação
item.description: The defense of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) uses a federal police intelligence report to request the dismissal of investigations related to INSS, questioning the performance of Minister André Mendonça and pointing to alleged irregularities in the conduct of inquiries. The document highlights lack of solid evidence against Lulinha and disagreement compared to other defendants.

item.title: Nos EUA, o pobre não tem o que tem no Brasil, diz Lula sobre SUS
item.description: During a visit to the Hospital de Amor in Barretos, Lula highlighted universal access to the SUS, contrasting it with the high costs of healthcare in the US, citing journalist Terrence McCoy's case. He also criticized Bolsonaro's pandemic management, recalling disinformation such as linking vaccines to sexual orientation.

item.title: Não se pode igualar Mendonça a Moraes
item.description: André Mendonça's appointment to the STF by Jair Bolsonaro in 2021 represents an unprecedented judicial polarization. Unlike previous more balanced appointments, this choice reflects an explicit ideological alignment. The text argues that comparing Mendonça to Moraes is inappropriate due to distinct contexts.

item.title: Representante do Brasil no Miss Mundo, Gabriela Botelho escolhe look inspirado no barroco mineiro para a final
item.description: Gabriela Botelho represents Brazil in the Miss World 2026 final wearing a blue baroque-inspired dress with exposed back and matching cape. With a degree in Business and Fashion Design, she is an ambassador for Casa de Maria and volunteered in Brumadinho after the dam collapse.

item.title: Em Barretos, Lula diz que SUS “ressurgiu das cinzas” e critica negacionismo
item.description: During a visit to a hospital in Barretos, Lula highlighted the role of SUS during the pandemic, stating that the system 'rose from the ashes' and criticized Bolsonaro's denialism regarding the Covid-19 vaccine, calling criminal statements that downplayed the effects of immunization. The president also reaffirmed the commitment to equitable access to health treatments in Brazil.

item.title: João Amoêdo vê Cury em alta, critica silêncio do Supremo no caso Moraes e ainda não define voto
item.description: João Amoêedo, outside partisan politics since leaving the New party, comments on Augusto Cury's rise in polls, criticizes the Supreme Court's silence in the Alexandre de Moraes case, and has not yet decided on his support.

item.title: Eleições 2026: candidaturas de autistas aumentam mais de cinco vezes
item.description: Autistic candidacies in Brazil grew more than fivefold between 2022 and 2026, rising from 13 to 70 filings. Notable are 39 running for state deputy and 22 for federal deputy. This increase reflects greater social visibility and recognition of disability rights, according to experts.

item.title: Investigação contra vice de Flávio Bolsonaro deve ser arquivada no STF
item.description: Minister Gilmar Mendes ordered the PGR to comment on the possible closure of the investigation against Alfredo Gaspar, Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate, for rape. The complaint emerged during the INSS CPI as an attempt to disqualify Gaspar, but was discovered to be false, fabricated by a merchant. The Prosecutor's Office has no deadline to decide on closing the case.

item.title: Coordenador de Lula vê “crise profunda” no STF e fala em modernização
item.description: Sergio Gabrielli, coordinator of Lula's government program, stated that the STF is facing a deep crisis and supports the modernization of the Judiciary, but emphasized that this is not part of a government plan. Lula also reinforced the need for pacification among the Powers and impartial investigations, although his program does not detail specific reforms for the Judiciary.

item.title: Valor de doações a Tarcísio é 260 vezes maior que o recebido por Haddad
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas campaign raised R$3.9 million in individual donations, 260 times more than the R$15,000 received by Fernando Haddad. Despite the disparity, the overall cash balances are similar, with Tarcísio holding R$13.7 million compared to Haddad's R$13.09 million including party transfers.

item.title: Crepúsculo dos deuses (por André Gustavo Stumpf)
item.description: The text examines the cycle of rise and fall of Brazilian political leaders like Collor, Dirceu, Moro and Lula, highlighting how issues they created led to imprisonment or loss of office. It illustrates the volatility of political careers through power games, allegations, and judicial proceedings.

item.title: Nova pesquisa BTG/Nexus testa Lula x Flávio após crise no STF e cenário com Cury no segundo turno
item.description: The latest BTG/Nexus poll shows the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro following the Supreme Court crisis, testing various electoral scenarios including potential head-to-head matchups in a second round.

item.title: Fluminense e Vasco fazem clássico carioca em momentos distintos no Brasileirão
item.description: Fluminense and Vasco face off at Maracanã in the 26th round of the Brazilian Championship, with the Tricolor unbeaten and in fourth place, while the Cruz-Maltino seeks to escape the relegation zone. The match follows Vasco's advancement to the Copa do Brasil semifinals.

item.title: Botafogo x Palmeiras: Escalações, desfalques, retrospecto, onde assistir, arbitragem e palpites
item.description: Botafogo faces Palmeiras in the 26th round of the 2026 Brazilian Championship at 6:30 PM at Nilton Santos Stadium, broadcasted on Premiere, Record, and CazéTV. With 30 points and under pressure to escape relegation, the Rio de Janeiro team seeks to reverse two losses. Managed by Abel Ferreira, the league leaders aim to extend their lead.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis neste fim de semana (5 e 6)
item.description: This weekend, presidential candidates carry out campaign events such as launches, walks, leafleting, and visits, with emphasis on Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula, Zema, Caiado, and others. Each candidate follows a political agenda across various regions of Brazil, involving public appearances, interviews, and meetings with voters and allies.

item.title: Fachin indica intenção de levar ao plenário crise envolvendo Moraes e Mendonça
item.description: The President of the Supreme Court, Edson Fachin, signaled to Lula his intention to bring the crisis involving justices Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça to the plenary session. The crisis stems from accusations and inquiries requiring a collective review by the Court. Fachin emphasized the need for a firm response to the gravity of revelations, particularly the connections between banker Daniel Vorcaro and judicial and political figures.

item.title: Letícia Barros na Crusoé: Renan Santos e o Judiciário que dita o algoritmo
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court unilaterally removed a piece from Renan Santos's campaign board, 14 days after the campaign began. Renan, who previously supported Moraes's actions against Bolsonaro in 2021, now faces judicial decisions affecting his electoral trajectory in the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Cruzeiro x Athletico-PR: prováveis escalações, arbitragem, onde assistir, retrospecto e palpites
item.description: Cruzeiro and Athletico-PR face off in the 26th round of the Brazilian Championship at Mineirão, with the match scheduled for Sunday at 4 PM. The Raposa, in fourth place, aims to maintain its strong form with four consecutive wins, while the Furacão, third-place, seeks to surprise away from home.

item.title: Frente fria muda o tempo em SP e Defesa Civil alerta para chuva forte
item.description: A cold front brings heavy rains to São Paulo, with civil defense warnings for flood and landslide risks, particularly in the Vale do Ribeira and Metropolitan Region. The National Institute of Meteorology keeps the entire state on storm alert, while the capital faces cold temperatures and highs around 22°C. Unstable weather conditions are expected to continue throughout the extended weekend of September 7th.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais: como ficou a disputa Lula x Flávio após os números da semana
item.description: Recent polls show Lula leading Flávio in the first round, but a technical tie in the second round. Augusto Cury holds third place with consistent support.

item.title: Senador entrega santinho para Tereza Cristina e pede voto: 'Conhece muita gente'
item.description: Senator Izalci Lucas (PL-DF), running for federal deputy in Brasília, handed out campaign flyers at the Senate during the concentrated effort week and asked for votes for colleague Tereza Cristina (PP-MS), emphasizing her connections in Brasília. The campaign material did not list Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) number.

item.title: Maior força militar da América Latina avança com tecnologia de última geração e chama atenção do mundo
item.description: Brazil ranks as the leading military power in Latin America in the 2026 Global Firepower ranking, driven by fighter jets, transport aircraft, border surveillance systems and submarines. While showcasing technological upgrades, this leadership does not place it on par with major global powers. The military expansion fuels discussions on national defense and Brazil’s regional role.

item.title: Rio terá forças federais nas eleições para reforçar segurança
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court authorized the deployment of federal forces in Rio de Janeiro for the 2026 elections to enhance security at around 5,000 polling stations. The measure aims to prevent criminal organizations from interfering in areas under their control and to ensure free and fair voting. The decision was unanimously approved by the TSE, with support from the state government.

item.title: Inquérito das fake news: relembre decisões que marcaram a investigação sob relatoria de Moraes no STF
item.description: The STF fake news inquiry, established seven years ago, investigated attacks and misinformation against the Court under rapporteur Alexandre de Moraes. The case produced controversial rulings, including social media account blocked and the arrest of Daniel Silveira, intensifying debates over free speech and judicial oversight. Currently, the case resurfaces amid criticism regarding its expansive investigative scope.

item.title: Defeso eleitoral derruba audiência da EBC em até 76%
item.description: EBC's audience plummeted after the start of the election silence period, with drops of up to 76% in Agência Brasil between June and July 2026. The state-owned company was defeated at the TSE when trying to reverse the restrictions, which significantly impacted the number of users and views.

item.title: Em guerra com Moraes, Mendonça pede preces e se cala sobre caso Master
item.description: Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça clashed at the STF, with Fachin stepping in to de-escalate the fake news investigation. Mendonça turned to religious appeals on social media, emphasizing his evangelical identity as a shield strategy.

item.title: Sete anos depois, uma porta de saída para o Inquérito das Fake News?
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin decided to close the Fake News Inquiry, opened in 2019 to investigate attacks against the court. The investigation became central in the fight against Bolsonarism and helped uncover disinformation networks, but faced criticism regarding its duration and excessive concentration of power. Now, a debate arises on how to conclude the inquiry without harming ongoing cases.

item.title: Fluminense busca revanche contra o Vasco; veja as odds
item.description: Fluminense faces Vasco at Maracanã for the 26th round of the Brazilian Championship, with the Tricolor seeking revenge after elimination in the Cup. The odds favor Fluminense, with markets such as win, draw and both scoring available for betting.

item.title: Brasil estreia na Copa do Mundo Feminina Sub-20 neste sábado; veja guia
item.description: Brazil makes its debut in the 2026 Women's U-20 World Cup on Saturday (5), at 10 a.m., facing Tanzania in Group B, held in Poland until September 27. The tournament brings together 24 national teams competing for the country's first title in this category, with the best performance being third place in 2022.

item.title: Estratégia de colocar parentes em chapas ao Senado se espalha nas eleições
item.description: The strategy of placing relatives in elected positions, especially in the Senate, has expanded in the 2026 elections, with figures like Michelle Bolsonaro and Helder Barbalho leading tickets composed of family members. This phenomenon, already present in previous elections, reflects the growing influence of family ties in Brazilian politics. Despite the increasing presence of relatives on lists, the practice raises debates about nepotism and unequal access to power.

item.title: Janja tenta separar Lula de eleitora que o abraçou em ato no Ceará
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva intervened during a campaign event in Ceará to separate President Lula from a supporter who hugged him. The video, captured by SBT News, shows the interaction in Juazeiro do Norte, highlighted by O Antagonista.

item.title: Lula e Haddad fazem campanha em São José do Rio Preto neste sábado (5/9)
item.description: Lula and Haddad hold a campaign rally in São José do Rio Preto under the slogan 'SP Ready for More', alongside Alckmin, Marina Silva, and Simone Tebet. Prior to the event, Lula visits the Dream facility at Hospital de Amor in Barretos to tour new health infrastructure.

item.title: Dono da Naskar completa 2 meses foragido enquanto tira onda no exterior
item.description: Douglas Azara, 26, has been on the run for two months after being accused of embezzling R$60 million from Zema Financeira, owned by Romeu Zema's family. Despite an outstanding arrest warrant, he flaunts travels to Dubai and Madrid on social media, mocking victims of the Naskar fraud.

item.title: Com Barrichello, Monza foi palco da última vitória brasileira na Fórmula 1
item.description: The 2009 Italian Grand Prix at Monza marked the last victory by a Brazilian driver in Formula 1, achieved by Rubens Barrichello driving for Brawn GP. A strategic race with minimal pit stops proved decisive. Since then, no Brazilian driver has managed to win a race in the top category again.

item.title: Do CPF ao Rock in Rio: como Oli Sykes, do Bring Me The Horizon, virou quase um brasileiro
item.description: Oli Sykes, lead singer of the British band Bring Me The Horizon, has been married to Brazilian model Alissic since 2017. He settled in Brazil, buying homes in Taubaté and Ubatuba, obtaining a CPF, securing residency status, and immersing himself in local culture such as Carnival street parades and typical dietary habits. His deep connection with the country also impacted both his personal life and the band's musical direction.

item.title: É preciso reconstruir, e não implodir a democracia
item.description: The article warns of the risk of democratic collapse in Brazil, citing threats such as far-right coup plotting, foreign electoral interference, internal conflicts within the Supreme Court, and political system decay. The author questions who benefits from democratic crisis and emphasizes the need to rebuild, rather than undermine, the institutional system.

item.title: STF Futebol Clube nunca falhou com Moraes, porque Moraes nunca falhou com ele
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes was caught in controversial conversations with Daniel Vorcaro, suggesting the fake news inquiry should target colleague André Mendonça, causing a crisis at the STF. The stance of the justices and the reaction of parties and President Lula were of bewilderment and indignation.

item.title: Quaest: veja os grupos em que a disputa entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro está mais apertada
item.description: A new Quaest poll shows a tight technical tie between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in a hypothetical presidential runoff, with 42% and 41% of voting intentions respectively, within the 2-point margin of error. The race remains close across several demographics, including voters aged 35 to 59, independents, and the Center-West/North region, although Lula leads in the Northeast and among low-income earners.

item.title: VÍDEO: Entenda como o TSE testa as urnas eletrônicas antes das eleições
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) conducts public tests of electronic voting machines before elections to ensure system security. Since 2009, no participant has identified flaws that could compromise vote secrecy or election results.

item.title: Citado por Lula, Defesa terá 6º maior orçamento em 2027; verba inclui submarino nuclear, caças Gripen e mísseis de longo alcance
item.description: The Ministry of Defense will have the sixth largest budget in 2027, with R$148 billion, according to the proposal sent to Congress. President Lula justified the increase due to international tensions and internal threats, including funding for nuclear submarines and fighter jets. Most of the budget will go to personnel and social charges.

item.title: MAPA: Quaest mostra como está a disputa presidencial nos estados
item.description: Quaest polls show Lula (PT) leading beyond the margin of error in nine states, while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads in seven. In the three largest electoral colleges — São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Rio de Janeiro — the race is statistically tied. Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) is the only candidate leading numerically, in Goiás.

item.title: De olho no público jovem e no Nordeste, Augusto Cury gastou R$ 116 mil nas redes sociais em 2026
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) spent R$116,000 on paid ads on Instagram and other Meta platforms to attract young voters and those in the Northeast, with peaks of R$43,900 in seven days. His content promotion strategy, including a video of the first presidential debate, helped raise his voting intentions from 2% to 10% and from 1% to 14% among younger voters.

item.title: Augusto Cury: estreante e surpresa da eleição, escritor flertou com candidatura à Presidência 17 anos atrás
item.description: Augusto Cury, a 68-year-old author and political newcomer, launched his pre-candidacy for President by the Avante party, emerging as a third-place contender in recent polls with 8% to 10% support. He stands out for proposing to break the polarization between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, advocating for an end to reelection and stating that public offices belong to taxpayers. His campaign has grown on social media, though he has faced suspicions of irregular practices, which he denies.

item.title: Eleições 2026: o que os candidatos à Presidência propõem para o STF
item.description: Presidential candidates in 2026 propose reforms to the STF, focusing on limiting powers, establishing fixed terms, and restricting unilateral decisions. Lula maintains dialogue with the judiciary, while Flávio and Cury advocate structural changes. The crisis involving the STF and PGR over the Banco Master case is central to the debate.

item.title: Janja afasta eleitora que deu abraço em Lula no Ceará
item.description: During a campaign rally in Juazeiro do Norte (CE), a voter hugged President Lula, wrapping her arms around his neck, prompting first lady Janja to intervene. The incident sparked mixed reactions on social media, criticizing the voter and praising Janja's protective stance. Lula visited Ceará to support allies, including Elmano de Freitas (PT) for governor and Cid Gomes (PSB-CE) and Luizianne Lins (Rede-CE) for the Senate.

item.title: Crítica: Em família, Capital Inicial e Dado Villa-Lobos fecham o Palco Sunset com homenagem justa a Renato Russo
item.description: The Capital Inicial show with Dado Villa-Lobos at Rock in Rio 2026 was a symbolic tribute to Renato Russo, highlighting historical connections between the artists and the Electric Abort band. The performance featured classics from Legião Urbana and Capital itself, celebrating the late guitarist's legacy. Despite a minor stumble at the start, the atmosphere was positive and emotional for the audience.

item.title: Zema defende dividir a Petrobras em até 5 empresas caso eleito
item.description: Romeu Zema proposes splitting Petrobras into up to five companies as part of his privatization strategy, arguing that this measure will increase competition and benefit consumers. He also advocates using the funds from the sale of the state-owned company for investments in infrastructure, education, and health.

item.title: Dinho dedica 'Que país é este' a Vorcaro, a ministros do STF e a políticos de direita, centro e esquerda
item.description: Dinho Ouro Preto dedicated the song 'Que país é este' to banker Daniel Vorcaro and Supreme Court ministers during Rock in Rio 2026, demanding accountability from politicians across the spectrum. The act took place at the Sunset Stage alongside Capital Inicial.

item.title: Saiba quem são os 7 governadores que podem ser eleitos no 1º turno
item.description: Seven governors lead with enough margin to win in the first round of the 2026 elections, according to recent polling data. The race in four other states remains highly competitive, with technical ties between frontrunners.
